description: Use this when the user approved a structured quote request to 1 to 3 Servana businesses (usually from the prepare_quote_request form). Servana formats the details the businesses asked for and emails the user their replies. If details are missing it returns which ones; ask the user, never invent. Do not use to book or pay; Servana does neither.

details.description: Field values keyed by: date_window, time_window, area, home_size, job_details, frequency, session_goal, session_count, treatment, shoot_type, duration, people_count, load_size, budget

name: request_quote
